def can_alice_have_strictly_larger_weight(n, m, k, alice_fish, bob_fish):
    # Calculate the total weight of fish caught by Alice and Bob
    alice_total_weight = sum(alice_fish)
    bob_total_weight = sum(bob_fish)
    
    # If Alice has caught more fish than Bob, check if she can have a strictly larger total weight
    if n > m:
        return "YES"
    
    # If Bob has caught more fish than Alice, Alice cannot have a strictly larger total weight
    if n < m:
        return "NO"
    
    # If they have caught the same number of fish, compare the sums of their weights
    if alice_total_weight > bob_total_weight:
        return "YES"
    else:
        return "NO"
